npx prettier --write src/types/sessionStore.ts src/types/session.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/listSessions.test.ts src/index.ts

git add -A && git commit -m "feat(transport): add StoreCannotList exception and UNSUPPORTED error code

Implements support for distinguishing between a store that doesn't support
listing (StoreCannotList) vs. one that failed to list (SERVER_ERROR). When
a store throws StoreCannotList during listFor, the handler now responds
with UNSUPPORTED error code instead of SERVER_ERROR.

This allows deployments to clearly signal that history listing is
misconfigured at the store level, rather than a transient failure.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
